provenance.notes: A starting point, nothing read yet: read __Title__'s terms and usage policy at their source today, fill this file in and set verifiedAt to that day; what the terms do not publish stays unknown (null, "unknown"), never "allowed" - a site cannot loosen it. rateLimits: null while unknown, [] when the terms set none; each limit's window (second, minute, hour, day, month) and "every" for several of them (500 every 5 minutes), its scope (application, key, client-ip, user, or resource with "per": 6 a day per parcel, counted under the operation the provider names), its operations, its "unit" (requests, characters, units, points) and each operation's "cost". concurrency: the requests the terms let run at once. plans: the published plans' limits (Free, Pro...), a default one, the factory's "plan" option picking another. rights: commercial use, open source, caching (maxTtl), storage, redistribution, the credit, the licence, retention (how long the data may be kept at all). requirements: a key, a User-Agent. omnisense/contracts' docs/declare-your-policy.md says how, field by field.
